services.name: Winter Fishing
services.desc: Fishing can be a challenge during the winter months for several reasons if you don’t understand the factors that play a role in catching fish. During the Winter months the daily tides bring less water onto the flats forcing fish to move farther off the flats or farther into small creeks and bayous that may hold enough water flow and food for them to survive through the winter. Some of these creeks and bayous are not accessible by boat when the tide is low thus providing a safe haven for the fish. Most fish require 1-3 feet of water to live and feed in.
